title: teslalog: Vampire Drain
description: Battery/range lost while parked (not driving, not charging) - matching TeslaMate's own Vampire Drain dashboard. Derived from consecutive battery_samples rows with no drive/charge session starting in between, filtered to gaps at least $min_idle_hours long.

targets.queryText:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    battery_level,
    battery_range_km,
    LAG(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_ts,
    LAG(battery_level) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_level,
    LAG(battery_range_km) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_range
  FROM battery_samples
)
SELECT
  prev_ts AS time,
  timestamp AS "End",
  ROUND((julianday(timestamp) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24, 1) AS "Period (h)",
  prev_level AS "Start %",
  battery_level AS "End %",
  (battery_level - prev_level) AS "SoC diff",
  ROUND(prev_range - battery_range_km, 2) AS "Range loss (km)",
  ROUND((prev_range - battery_range_km) / ((julianday(timestamp) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24), 2) AS "km lost / h"
FROM samples
WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday(timestamp) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24 >= $min_idle_hours
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM drives WHERE start_time > prev_ts AND start_time < timestamp)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM charging_sessions WHERE start_time > prev_ts AND start_time < timestamp)
ORDER BY prev_ts DESC
LIMIT 200
